title: Which IPC should I use?
description:
Write a helper that suggests an IPC method from a few questions.

```
same machine? yes, big data? yes, many clients? no  -> shared memory with an event
same machine? yes, big data? no, many clients? yes  -> a named pipe server
same machine? no                                    -> TCP sockets
only a parent and child?                            -> anonymous pipes
```
hints: Check the deciding question first: another machine rules out everything except sockets (lesson 1.05).
Return a `struct Suggestion { std::string method, reason; }` so the reason is never forgotten.
requirements: A `struct Needs` with a few `bool`s (same machine, parent and child only, large data, many clients, needs a reply).
`suggest(needs)` returns a method and a one-line reason.
stretch: Add "must work on Linux too" and adjust the suggestions.
